materials.title: Jen-Hsun Huang, NVIDIA co-founder, invests in the next generation of Stanford engineers
verified_claims: Interview recounts Huang aged 24 leading 30-odd engineers and feeling betrayed when a manager resigned.
He recounts later recognizing his mistake and being happy for departing employees; says this enabled some to return.
limits: Interviewee self-report; no independent causal test.
Direct Browser Harness and urllib access returned 403; web tool returned full primary page.
Does not verify current 2026 attitude or policy.
